g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB05 Creation of a New Product (Manager Action)
The Page validates the form; the adapter calls apiClient with a path relative to /api/v1
and the session access token. The back end remains authoritative (authentication,
MANAGER role, validation). Domain and persistence behaviour belongs to BCK05.
show localized field errors; preserve input
show safe, localized form-level message (WEB04); preserve input
show safe, localized business feedback (WEB04); preserve input
outcome unconfirmed (BR 25); block resubmission; check the product list
The server may have committed the product,
but the response never reaches the client.
